question: does the design-to window 100 <= K_s <= 130 N m/rad (RV6-01 text, V5c plant, CAD v3.3) hold on the 3D FE plant of CAD v3.5.1, and what is the window for each J and structure, with the corners that set it? (REV-GNC-6 RV6-14 (a)-(e); lead CHANGELOG 227 (3))
tags: DERIVED (linear CSI margins, m2_eng11 v1.1 model and corners) on SIM FE stiffness (FEA3D C7.1, CAD v3.5.1); K_s, J value, rocking damping, bending, the compliant-airframe spring and hot E ASSUMED; no hardware data; not physical approval; staged apart from the gnc.json v3.2 text (not folded)
grid: K_s 90-160 N m/rad step 5; edges known to +/-5 N m/rad; '<= 90' / '>= 160' are grid limits
criterion: ENG-07d: closed loop stable and upper GM >= 6 dB at every floor20 corner, continuous pose envelope (0.1 Hz + 0.02 Hz near the bending frequency), fixed ECU notch Q 1 / -12 dB at e 0.95 / 1 / 1.05 x the bench landing centre-pose mode, zeta 0.02 / 0.05 / 0.10

legend.corner: tank state (full / landing) | floor20 condition | actuator corner | aero corner | f<rocking-mode Hz at that pose and condition> | e<notch tuning factor> | z<rocking damping> [| GM<upper gain margin dB>]; two-mass rows name the pose (or 'A-B@x' on the skeleton) and f1 = the first (rocking) mode
legend.first_fail: the first corner below 6 dB in the evaluation order (full tank, zeta 0.02, near bending first)
legend.fail_block_worst: the lowest GM in that corner's (condition, e, zeta) block (lumped model only); -99.0 = closed loop UNSTABLE at that corner
legend.window: a contiguous run of passing grid points; '<= 90' / '>= 160' = the grid limit, not a found edge
legend.primary_window: the both-axes window overlapping the v3.2 design-to window 100-130 most (else the lowest)

proposal.status: PROPOSAL for the lead (227 (3) keeps the decision); DERIVED basis; not physical approval
findings: V5c plant (v3.2 basis, CAD v3.3), J 1.6e-3 cons: both axes pass 100-130 N m/rad (reproduces the v3.2 window).
FE plant (CAD v3.5.1), rigid airframe, T_REF, J 1.6e-3 cons: <= 90-120 N m/rad; over the FE structure set (rigid / compliant airframe, T_REF / hot E -5 / -10 %, cone / stop poses): <= 90-120.
J on the FE plant (cons): 0.76e-3 130->= 160; 1.6e-3 <= 90-120; 2.7e-3 120->= 160 N m/rad; all three J together: NONE.
n48 convention (J 0.76 / 1.6 / 2.7e-3): 130->= 160 / NONE (no K_s in 90-160 passes on both axes) / NONE (no K_s in 90-160 passes on both axes) N m/rad.
Rotor model: two-mass (J 1.6e-3) 150->= 160; J 0 (rotor out of the mode) <= 90->= 160 N m/rad.
First bending x 0.9 / x 1.1: FE NONE (no K_s in 90-160 passes on both axes) / <= 90->= 160; V5c NONE (no K_s in 90-160 passes on both axes) / 95->= 160 N m/rad.
proposal.design_to_rule: intersection of the V5c window (A12) and the FE structure-set window at the nominal J (group J_1.6_cons_FE_structure, else A01)

finding_fea3d_g_factor.what: FEA3D post_k servo factor g_fea (rod arm over the full horn radius, horn normal to the rod) against the exact CAD linkage kinematics g_kin (03-cad tvc_kinematics solve_psi, horn crank included): g_kin / g_fea
finding_fea3d_g_factor.consequence: FEA3D's 'with servo' engine stiffness (REPORT-FEA3D 9) under-counts the servo spring off-centre; GNC's primary plant uses the V5c g, which equals g_kin within 2.36 % on the cone; variant B04 flies g_fea for comparison
finding_fea3d_g_factor.tag: DERIVED (kinematics); for FEA3D / Mechanical, not a GNC requirement
